The final scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, though the exact mechanism of action remains unclear. The evidence suggests that Astersaponin F may exert its effects through the dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase, which is a key player in the signaling pathways of SMMC-7721. The integration of these findings highlights the importance of this kinase in the biological response of SMMC-7721 to Astersaponin F.
